# TechNurture

> TechNurture Pvt Ltd is a home-appliance service company in Sri Lanka, providing fast, reliable repair, servicing and maintenance for air conditioners, refrigerators and washing machines. Genuine parts, trained technicians and island-wide coverage. A subsidiary of Lusako Holdings Pvt Ltd. Tagline: "Technology Inspired by Nurture".

## Services

- [Air Conditioning](https://technurture.lk/services/air-conditioning): AC repair, servicing, gas charging and installation for split, inverter and commercial systems.
- [Refrigerator & Freezer](https://technurture.lk/services/refrigerator): fridge and freezer repair — no-cooling, gas refilling, compressor, thermostat and door-seal faults, domestic and commercial.
- [Washing Machine](https://technurture.lk/services/washing-machine): repair of drain, spin, motor, drum, PCB and water-inlet faults on front-load, top-load and fully-automatic machines.
- [Maintenance & AMC](https://technurture.lk/services/maintenance-amc): Annual Maintenance Contracts (Comprehensive, Non-Comprehensive, On-Call) and preventive maintenance for home appliances.

## Company

- [About TechNurture](https://technurture.lk/about): a subsidiary of Lusako Holdings with over a decade of experience serving banks, hospitals, corporates and institutions across Sri Lanka.
- [Blog](https://technurture.lk/blog): practical guides on appliance repair and preventive maintenance.

## Contact

- [Contact & quotation](https://technurture.lk/contact): request a quote, book a repair or maintenance visit. Island-wide service across Sri Lanka. (Phone, WhatsApp and email listed on the site.)
